# Farm land for sale

> An opportunity to acquire a block of traditional grazing marshes extending in all to approximately 29.06Ha (71.81 acres) with frontage onto the A47 Acle New Road. The majority of the marshes are located between the road and the mainline railway with a further block located on the southern side of the railway line.

## Fakta
- Typ: farm land
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: studio
- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Lokalita: Grazing Marshes, Great Yarmouth
- Cena: £290,000
